decisive_items: initial diagnosis was transient ischemic attack of the vertebrobasilar system
carotid MRA showed carotid arteriosclerosis with limited stenosis of the intracranial left vertebral artery
response.rationale: Episodic transient slurred speech with vertebrobasilar stenosis and unremarkable MRI best fits a vertebrobasilar TIA; negative neostigmine/fatigue tests do not exclude TIA, and no infarction excludes stroke. R2 is a less precise synonym, while R5/R7 are nonspecific or unsupported.

rejected.why: No infarction on MRI and symptoms are transient, not a fixed stroke.
Cerebral arteriosclerosis is an imaging/risk finding, not a specific clinical diagnosis.
Less precise than R1; the vignette explicitly labels the event as transient ischemic attack of the vertebrobasilar system.
Normal MRI/SWI, normal inflammatory labs, and no systemic vasculitic features do not support vasculitis.
